scope: Source inspection and referenced real HTTP tests of live identity/app/generation/role checks; not an independent security certification
observations: Identity active() checks exact current generation, exact active device, trusted device and session expiry.
Capability is signed, persisted as exact canonical payload, bound to app proof key, required scope and consumed nonce.
authorityCurrent checks persisted issued owner/admin truth against current server DB/callback values; token roles are not client flags.
ADMIN authorize/isActive additionally require current administrator, current step-up and absence of sensitive recovery pending.
Management separately enforces AEGIS+ADMIN, two distinct account IDs for restore, exact request body, fresh approval lifetime, persistent one-use operation ID and intent audit before fixed commands.
Attachment server checks exact metadata digest then actual immutable cipherchunk length/hash; app is MAIL with required scope and bounded live recheck.
Glas root delegation binds existing account root to current GLAS app/device/generation; endpoint binds service pin; both directional contact policies and target live token are checked.

limitations.detail: Management/Attachment signed request body has typed protocol domain but no receiving-instance public-key audience. One logical service/storage per Identity issuer is assumed; independently isolated environments must use different Identity issuer or add service audience binding before sharing issuer.

Root helper now performs fixed quiesce, bounded opaque copies and SHA inventory only. SQLite is parsed per database by a DynamicUser systemd RootDirectory validator, with no network, no foreign DB or secret mounts, memory/CPU/time limits, seccomp and AppArmor. Portable real kernel socket denial and actual unsandboxed worker refusal PASS. Full UID/chroot fixtures and Debian13 systemd/AppArmor remain NOT_RUN because Work has no required kernel capabilities/PID1; the exact Debian system Python SQLite is outside JDBC SBOM and requires native patch validation. No production backup or offsite restore ran.
Legacy Relay LOGIN6/generation bridge belongs to root/identity agent and is not proven by these attachment/signaling tests.
